description: Implementation of the HeadersPayloadDecoder class for HTTP/2 header payload decoding, including state management and frame processing logic.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for processing HTTP/2 header frame payloads, managing decoding states and invoking listener callbacks.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator to print the string representation of PayloadState enum values.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Begins decoding the header payload, handling special cases for frames with only HPACK data or with padding/priority flags.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Continues decoding the header payload, managing different payload states and invoking appropriate listener callbacks.
